twoFactor.heading: Two-step verification
twoFactor.subtitle: A code from your phone, in addition to your password.
twoFactor.manageDescription: Add this panel to an authenticator app to require a code at every sign-in.
twoFactor.enrolInstructions: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, or add the secret below by hand, then enter the code it shows.
twoFactor.recoveryWarning: Save these now. Each works once, and they will not be shown again.
twoFactor.disableDescription: Enter a current code, or one of your recovery codes, to turn this off.
twoFactor.disableConfirmQuestion: Signing in will need only your password. Anyone who learns it can get into this panel, and your recovery codes will stop working.
twoFactor.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
twoFactor.enabledDescription: Every sign-in asks for a code from your authenticator app.
